body: W3 API seam note while you build P0-2 phase 2: my held snapshot currently binds ReidentificationKey to payload.digest and will switch its source/detection identities to sealed ReceiptDigest. Please preserve a portable way for PseudonymizedText.checked to compute/receive the policy-keyed identity without exposing Plain/Keyed constructors; likely checked gains SensitiveKeyProvider (or a private verified ReceiptDigest). I will own detector types/signature after your candidate, so no need to add them. When you post, please call out the exact PseudonymizedText.checked/digest and RemotePolicy.evaluate signatures so I can rebase cleanly.
